paragraphs.text: Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba participated in Founding of Liga del Cedro Lunar on 2010-11-18. Liga del Cedro Lunar was linked to Founding of Liga del Cedro Lunar on 2010-11-18. Founding of Liga del Cedro Lunar occurred at Guadalajara on 2010-11-18. A detained courier in contact with the reporting office stated that Montemayor, a veterinarian who ran a livestock feed business in Guadalajara and whom the crews called El Cirujano, financed the construction of the first synthetic drug laboratories in the Tierra Caliente of Michoacán and brought the lab crews and the Guadalajara distribution side together under one name. The courier described the founding as a series of meetings at the feed business rather than a single event.

Octavio Galván Soto participated in Founding of Liga del Cedro Lunar on 2010-11-18. Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba used DEMO-ACCT-00066 on 2010-11-18. Founding of Liga del Cedro Lunar transited Tierra Caliente plaza on 2010-11-18. The courier identified Galván, called El Químico, as the man who recruited the chemists and sourced the laboratory supplies. The account identifier above was described as the one Montemayor used to pay for the first consignments of glassware and chemicals. The courier stated that the laboratories were sited in the hill country above Apatzingán where the network already controlled the roads.

Liga del Cedro Lunar controlled Tierra Caliente plaza from 2010-11-18 until 2018-06-30. Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba led Liga del Cedro Lunar from 2010-11-18 until 2018-04-26. The courier characterized Montemayor as the unquestioned head of the network and as a man who kept his veterinary practice open as cover. The reporting office assesses the courier as having direct access to the laboratory side of the network and secondhand access to its financing. The reporting office continues to collect on the entities named in this report.
